name: Mean value problem
informal: 对任意次数 d ≥ 2 的复多项式 p 和复数 z，存在 p 的临界点 c，使 |p(z) − p(c)| / |z − c| ≤ |p′(z)|。

references.label: The fundamental theorem of algebra and complexity theory
The fundamental theorem of algebra and complexity theory
Critical points and values of complex polynomials

informal_en:
Given a complex polynomial $p$ of degree $d ≥ 2$ and a complex number $z$
there is a critical point $c$ of $p$, such that $|p(z)-p(c)|/|z-c| ≤ |p'(z)|$.
